name: simplejson

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.3.0"

package:
  name: simplejson
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/s/simplejson/simplejson-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ffe34ab51a0d37e6d1c661a5672df00d2d5e18804e38eac07abffb83fa5ec3d7

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: unix
      then: export REQUIRE_SPEEDUPS=1
    - if: win
      then: set REQUIRE_SPEEDUPS=1
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >=42
    - pip
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - simplejson
        - simplejson._speedups
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Simple, fast, extensible JSON encoder/decoder for Python
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/simplejson/simplejson
  repository: https://github.com/simplejson/simplejson

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ainafp
    - ocefpaf
